title: Prove launch dialogs, dictation and startup recovery at their own owners

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: one targeted scratch break check

Verdict: Caught.

Story and revision: SEED-413#make-launch-proof-orthogonal ("Prove launch dialogs, dictation and startup recovery at their own owners"), plan 768-make-launch-proof-orthogonal Slice 2 / G2. Revision 25e0f9a559a4c60916d0cd5a5b1d423bbcff0dd0, run in an isolated detached scratch worktree ($CLAUDE_JOB_DIR/tmp/ic-scratch) after `npm ci`. The pre-probe state was clean.

Promise: after you select a model and effort and then dismiss the dialog, the next opening shows the defaults again. This is proved once at the shared dialog.

Validating the suggested fault: production gets this reset from unmounting. LaunchDialog says it is "Mounted only while open", StartLaunch renders `{open && <LaunchDialog…>}`, and useLaunchSettings starts with model "" and the host's default effort. Neither StartLaunch nor StartSession holds model or effort, so the realistic regression is the suggested "carry the last chosen model/effort into the next opening" in the shared settings hook. I did not use "keep the dialog mounted" because LaunchDialog opens only on mount (showModal in its mount effect). That fault would stop the dialog opening at all, not show the old choice.

Fault: dashboard/src/useLaunchSettings.ts. I added a module-level Map, keyed by host, that remembers the last model and effort set through setModel/setEffort. The initial state and the reset effect on sourceId/host read from that Map. No fixtures or assertions were changed.

Maintained checks: launch-model-effort.spec.ts, launch-host-catalog.spec.ts and launch-refinement-options.spec.ts (13 cases), using the focused command given with --workers=2.

Runs:
- Baseline: 13/13 passed (Vitest duration 13.69 s; load average about 21).
- Faulted: 2 failed, 11 passed (duration 40.19 s, mostly two 15 s expect.element timeouts).
  - The target catch is launch-model-effort.spec.ts:104, "dismissing with Cancel or Escape resets the chosen model and effort when the dialog opens again". After Cancel and `reopen("claude")` (a remount with a new key in launch-host-options-page.ts), the assertion at line 119, `expect.element(form.model).toHaveValue("")`, failed with Received "fable".
  - Collateral: launch-model-effort.spec.ts:73 (host-switch reset) failed at line 87, expecting effort "medium" and receiving "low". The fault also brings back the remembered choice when switching back to a host, so that is a second consequence of the same fault, not the dismissal path.
  - The per-launcher cases at lines 136 and 145 (story card execution/refinement and Start session dismissal and focus) passed, as expected. They only check close and focus return.
- Independent witness on a real launcher: a temporary spec in the scratch checkout mounted the story card launches with mountStoryLaunches. It clicked Start refinement, selected fable/max, clicked Cancel, then clicked Start refinement again. Under the fault the reopened dialog showed model="fable" and effort="max", and the witness failed. On restored code it showed model="" and effort="medium", and the witness passed. So the wrong behavior is real through a production launcher's real close and reopen, not only through the test's key remount. The witness file was deleted afterwards.
- Restoration: `git checkout -- dashboard/src/useLaunchSettings.ts` and the witness removed. `git status --short --untracked-files=all` in the scratch checkout was empty (identical to pre-probe), and HEAD was still 25e0f9a55. The focused command was rerun: 13/13 passed (duration 12.87 s; load average about 29). The scratch worktree was then removed with `git worktree remove`.

Bounds: the catch covers a fault in the shared settings hook, which affects every launcher the same way. The dialog-level case would not catch a launcher-specific regression that keeps the same LaunchDialog instance alive across a dismissal. No such variant is plausible today without restructuring how the dialog opens. It was not probed.

Next proof action: none needed for this promise. The dialog-level reset case catches the carried-over-choice fault, and the per-launcher cases need only their launch and focus handoff.

Prior disposition: this matches plan 768 Slice 2's intended design (one reset case at the shared dialog, per-launcher dismissal and focus only). The probe adds no new repair decision.

Costs:
- Test runtime (measured, Vitest "Duration" per run): baseline 13.69 s, faulted 40.19 s, restored 12.87 s, plus two single-case witness runs (about 15.5 s faulted case time; restored not separately recorded). Total for the focused runs about 66.8 s.
- Human effort: unavailable. No human took part during the probe.
- Agent effort: unavailable. There is no separately supported token or turn measure available to this agent.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 231733 ms (measured), from 1795333228000 to 1795333459733 in Unix epoch ms.

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision 25e0f9a559a4c60916d0cd5a5b1d423bbcff0dd0; verdict Caught; no follow-up.
